pull.title: ci: verify downloaded CI dependencies
pull.body:
**Problem:** CI downloads and uses lint binaries, macOS and FreeBSD SDK archives, LLVM, IWYU, and RISC-V source trees, and the LLVM APT signing key.
The downloaded files are not verified, and Git branch or tag names can resolve to unreviewed commits.

**Fix:** Verify downloaded files against pinned SHA256 hashes and clone Git sources at reviewed commits before use.

@l0rinc can you elaborate in the PR description what you're actually checking and trusting?

I'm skeptical this is going to very useful if we simply set these hashes based on the current value and blindly update them every time CI breaks due to a mismatch. In the case of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35754#discussion_r3613118504 the trust assumption seems to be circular. But there might be a subset of checks that _are_ useful.
